policy.examCalibration: France Éducation international and CEFR define task format, ability targets and difficulty. Official DELF sample tasks are not bulk-copied into the internal bank.
policy.factSeeds: Prefer official/open public datasets for facts, situations and topic seeds. Generated training texts are original derivatives and retain provenance metadata.
policy.traceability: Every generated item must retain sourceSeedIds, verifiedAt, licence, authority, theme, DELF function and a stable content/trace ID.

sources.title: DELF B1 tout public
sources.use: Calibrate DELF B1 task structure, duration, minimum writing length and assessment expectations; do not bulk-copy official subjects.

sources.title: CEFR descriptors
sources.use: Map generated tasks to B1 communicative ability and progression.

sources.title: Fiches pratiques et ressources Service-Public.gouv.fr Particuliers
sources.use: Primary fact and situation seed bank for realistic B1 daily-life reading/listening tasks; preserve DILA attribution, download URL, file name and file date.

sources.title: Fiches pratiques et ressources Entreprendre
sources.use: Professional-life and workplace fact seeds for B1 application, reading and speaking tasks.

sources.title: Fiches pratiques Service-Public.fr vectorisées
sources.use: Topic retrieval and semantic discovery over Service-Public material; not treated as a separate factual authority from DILA originals.

sources.title: Annuaire de l'éducation
sources.use: Education and orientation fact seeds; useful for notices, comparisons, requests and practical information tasks.

sources.title: Données nationales relatives aux soins de ville
sources.use: Health-system and care fact seeds; use aggregated/public facts only and avoid medical advice generation.

sources.title: Données relatives à la santé
sources.use: Discovery catalog for health-related official datasets; each downstream dataset must retain its own licence and attribution.

sources.title: Réseau SNCF TGV, Intercités et TER - données ouvertes
sources.use: Transport schedule and travel-situation seeds; preserve ODbL attribution and do not imply real-time accuracy unless refreshed.

sources.title: Dares Explore API v2
sources.use: Programmatic discovery of official work/employment datasets for B1 fact-based tasks.

sources.title: Offres d'emploi diffusées à France Travail
sources.use: Job-market fact seeds for reading, comparison, application and opinion tasks.

sources.title: DPE logements neufs depuis juillet 2021
sources.use: Housing-energy and environmental fact seeds for B1 comparison, explanation and opinion tasks.

sources.title: Résultats des observatoires locaux des loyers par agglomération
sources.use: Housing/rent comparison facts for practical reading, discussion and argumentation tasks.
